## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger and the behavior before and after this change.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] `python -m pytest` passes.
- [ ] `python -m ruff check .` passes.
- [ ] `python -m build` passes when packaging changed.
- [ ] Documentation and safety limitations remain accurate.
- [ ] Fixtures are synthetic or publicly redistributable.
